import numpy as np
from sklearn.model_selection import train_test_split
from sklearn.feature_extraction.text import TfidfVectorizer
from sklearn.linear_model import LogisticRegression
from sklearn.metrics import roc_auc_score
import os
import re

# Create submission directory if it doesn't exist
os.makedirs("./submission", exist_ok=True)

# Load data
train_df = pd.read_csv("./input/train.csv")
test_df = pd.read_csv("./input/test.csv")

# Remove quotes from comments - they seem to be wrapped in quotes
train_df["Comment"] = train_df["Comment"].apply(
    lambda x: x.replace('"', "").replace("'", "").strip()
)
test_df["Comment"] = test_df["Comment"].apply(
    lambda x: x.replace('"', "").replace("'", "").strip()
)


# Simple preprocessing
# Tokenize and clean text
def clean_text(text):
    # Remove special characters except letters, numbers, spaces
    cleaned = re.sub(r"[^a-zA-Z0-9\s]", " ", text)
    # Collapse multiple spaces
    cleaned = re.sub(r"\s+", " ", cleaned).strip()
    return cleaned


train_df["Comment"] = train_df["Comment"].apply(clean_text)
test_df["Comment"] = test_df["Comment"].apply(clean_text)

# Get train/test split for validation
X_train_full, y_train_true = train_df["Comment"], train_df["Insult"]
X_test = test_df["Comment"]

# Split for validation (hold out some data)
X_tr, X_val, y_tr, y_val = train_test_split(
    X_train_full, y_train_true, random_state=42, stratify=y_train_true, test_size=0.2
)

# Vectorize text features
vectorizer = TfidfVectorizer(
    max_features=2000, ngram_range=(1, 2), min_df=2, stop_words="english"
)

X_train_vec = vectorizer.fit_transform(X_tr)
X_val_vec = vectorizer.transform(X_val)
X_test_vec = vectorizer.transform(test_df["Comment"])

# Train logistic regression
model = LogisticRegression(
    max_iter=1000, class_weight="balanced", random_state=42, C=1.0
)
model.fit(X_train_vec, y_tr)

# Validate on held-out set
y_val_pred = model.predict_proba(X_val_vec)[:, 1]
val_auc = roc_auc_score(y_val, y_val_pred)

print(f"Validation AUC-ROC Score: {val_auc:.6f}")

# Predictions for submission
